cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Still a Good Sign
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me order us dinner. First time since the breakup, and you still groan at my waiter joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You remembered the whole thing. We'll stick to food, then; I'll put the menu where we can both see it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just want to eat in silence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Silence it is. You still trust me to stay for that.

reason: Replace status padding with a shared ordering plan adapted to B preference; retain the hopeful reading of each rebuff and end on the acceptance of silence without an extra dessert move.
